title.zh: Kalshi、Polymarket中期选举前密集与CNN、CNBC等媒体合作
title.en: Kalshi、Polymarket中期选举前密集与CNN、CNBC等媒体合作

current_state.zh: Ahead of the November 3 US midterms, CNN, CBS News, Dow Jones and CNBC struck commercial deals with prediction markets Kalshi and Polymarket to cite election trading odds in coverage — including a CNBC revenue-share and minority equity investment in Kalshi and a WSJ odds column powered by Polymarket — with roughly $1.5B traded across the two platforms' election markets.
